children: Denmark freight forwarder's prelim Q3 revenue increased by 15.9% to DKK 3.41 bln, driven by higher freight rates and strong activity across both divisions
Q3 EPS was DKK 4.75; Adjusted EBIT for Q3 totaled DKK 188 mln
NTG raised FY26 EBIT before special items guidance last month to DKK 660-685 mln from DKK 625-650 mln
Last month, group increased expected FY26 special items to about DKK 50 mln from DKK 30-35 mln
FREIGHT RATES AND ACTIVITY – Higher freight rates and solid activity across both divisions drove 15.5% organic revenue growth; FX added 0.4%
AIR & OCEAN TURNAROUND – Higher activity, operating leverage and organisational right-sizing lifted Air & Ocean EBIT before special items 71.4% to DKK36 mln
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 7 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the ground freight & logistics peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for NTG Nordic Transport Group A/S is DKK335.00, about 4.9% above its November 6 closing price of DKK319.50
The stock recently traded at 17 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 15 three months ago
